conceptual assets.information: The four 32-bit words stored in key_mem are XTEA key material used by the encryption and decryption computations. The key material is also exposed through the CSR readback interface.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The key words can be exposed directly through csr_rdata_o at line 185. The key words can be overwritten through the CSR write at line 179, changing the cryptographic behavior.
conceptual assets.attack: Read csr_rdata_o to recover a key word or issue an unintended CSR write to replace one.

conceptual assets.information: The two 32-bit operand words captured for an XTEA operation are the data block processed with the stored key. The operands are held internally while the result is computed and are not returned unchanged.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The operand registers are loaded from rs1_i and rs2_i at lines 205-206 and feed the result computation at lines 222-238, so altering their capture can produce an incorrect result. The start and type condition at line 204 can prevent the operands from being captured, losing the required operation.
conceptual assets.attack: Alter or suppress operand capture when start_i is accepted so the CFU computes from incorrect or absent input data.

conceptual assets.information: csr_we_i together with csr_addr_i commands whether a key word is written and selects which key word is accessed. The command controls the key-configuration transfer rather than storing key data itself.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The write enable and selected address determine whether and which key word is modified at lines 178-179, so corrupting the command can cause an unintended key update. The same command path can withhold a required key write or select the wrong word at lines 178-185.
conceptual assets.attack: Assert or suppress csr_we_i, or provide a wrong csr_addr_i, to redirect or block a required key access.

conceptual assets.information: The start command initiates capture of operands and the selected custom XTEA operation. The operation-type and function fields select the accepted operation and its result behavior.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The start and operation-type conditions control operand capture and operation initiation at lines 204-207, while the selected function controls the computation and returned result at lines 213-225 and 247-256; changing them can produce an incorrect operation. The same conditions can prevent operation acceptance or suppress a valid result at lines 204 and 254-262.
conceptual assets.attack: Corrupt or withhold the start or accepted operation control so the CFU performs the wrong operation or does not produce one.

conceptual assets.information: The XTEA result computed from the captured operands and key is returned for the selected encryption or decryption operation. For decryption operations, the returned value may be sensitive plaintext.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The computed result is exposed at result_o on line 249, including values that can be plaintext for the decryption operations selected at line 248. The result register is computed from the operand and key-dependent datapath at lines 222-238, so corruption can change the returned value. The result and its delivery can be withheld by the result-selection logic at lines 249-262.
conceptual assets.attack: Observe a sensitive returned result, corrupt the result datapath, or prevent result_o from returning the computed value.

conceptual assets.information: valid_o indicates whether the selected operation has a result available or whether the initialization operation is accepted. The receiving processor depends on this status to recognize a usable result.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The status returned on valid_o is generated from the completion state and operation selection at lines 250-256, so an incorrect status can make the consumer accept an invalid result or reject a valid one. The result-selection branches can hold valid_o low and withhold the result transfer at lines 254-262.
conceptual assets.attack: Force valid_o high or low so the processor consumes an invalid result or never recognizes a completed operation.
